description: Rewrite the front door and consolidate the handoffs into exactly ONE internal handoff. Rewrite README.md as a complete index; merge docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md into IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md and delete the former; fold sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md's unique Definition-of-Done into the single handoff and replace its body with a pointer; simplify dowsure-implementation-handoff.md; light-touch simplify the two canonical design docs with a plain-English summary box each; and shorten docs/QUICKSTART.md to a 'start here' index. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 so links resolve and status/flows/opinions exist to point at.
steps: Rewrite README.md as the front door: a one-paragraph plain 'what this is', then a map of EVERY folder (sam/, nitro-enclave/, coordinator/, infra/, scripts/, tests/, archive/, docs/, api-mocks/), then a linked index of ALL docs INCLUDING the docs/ folder (currently omitted): the two canonical design docs (olea-dowsure-executive-proposal.md, olea-dowsure-technical-design.md), the ONE handoff (IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md), the ONE status doc (docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md), the flows doc (docs/FLOWS.md), docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md, docs/QUICKSTART.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM.md, dowsure-implementation-handoff.md, sam/README.md, nitro-enclave/README.md, sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md, sam/docs/POC_LIMITATIONS.md, and opinions.md. Keep the plain-English summary. Expand acronyms on first use. For status facts, link to the matrix - do not restate the EIF SHA-256 / PCRs. Correct any 'sandbox blocked/unavailable' wording to 'sandbox available for validation'. Remove the stale link to sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md if that doc is reduced to a pointer (point to the handoff instead).

Merge docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md INTO IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md so there is exactly ONE internal handoff. Carry over the unique content: (a) update the 'Next Steps' / 'next endpoint' guidance AWAY from getOrderMetrics TO Transactions (GET /finances/2024-06-19/transactions, listTransactions) + Financial Event Groups (GET /finances/v0/financialEventGroups) as the finances reorientation; (b) keep the fail-closed and no-local-mock guidance; (c) correct 'use the sandbox host, production host shown in reference' into the now-available-sandbox framing (sandbox endpoints + credentials available, provided out of band / stored as secrets - never write values); (d) add the two named sample suppliers as onboarding test cases (Quanzhou Feile E-commerce Co., Ltd and Xiamen Yunyu Tianji Network Technology Co., Ltd - labels only); (e) add the 10-Oct Dowsure dependency with Anudeep Sai Nunna as owner. Then delete docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md with `git rm 'docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md'`. Keep the handoff's verified-state block consistent with the matrix (link where possible; the handoff may retain the measurements block since it is the historical capture, but it MUST match the matrix character-for-character).

Fold sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md's unique Definition-of-Done / success-criteria into IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md (as an acceptance/Definition-of-Done section if not already covered), then replace the body of sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md with a one-line pointer to IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md (deletion is awkward because sam/README.md links to it; keep the file as a pointer and update sam/README.md's link text accordingly, or point it at the handoff).

Simplify dowsure-implementation-handoff.md (the canonical Dowsure-FACING handoff): shorten prose, expand acronyms on first use, keep the mermaid diagrams and the defined interfaces/JSON. Ensure it does NOT contradict the single internal handoff or the status matrix (same CID 16/port 5005, same TLSNotary-placeholder stance, same finances reorientation). Add a plain-English summary box at the top.

Light-touch simplify olea-dowsure-executive-proposal.md and olea-dowsure-technical-design.md: add a short plain-English summary box at the top of each; simplify the intro paragraphs; expand jargon on first use (SP-API, LWA, TLSNotary, Nitro Enclave, PCR, EIF, COSE, CBOR, RDT, vsock, TEE). PRESERVE substance - do not cut tables, threat models, sequence diagrams, or the decision log. Correct only clearly stale claims (sandbox framing) if present; otherwise leave the canonical content intact.

Shorten docs/QUICKSTART.md to a 'start here' index: link README, docs/FLOWS.md, docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md, docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md, and opinions.md. Remove its restated 'honest current status' block and instead link to the status matrix. Keep it short.
acceptance_criteria: README.md indexes every folder and every doc including the docs/ folder and opinions.md, with status facts linked to the matrix (not restated).

docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md no longer exists; IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md is the single internal handoff and its 'next endpoint' guidance points to Transactions + Financial Event Groups, keeps fail-closed + no-local-mock, names the two sample suppliers, and records the 10-Oct Dowsure dependency with Anudeep as owner.
sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md is reduced to a one-line pointer to the handoff (its Definition-of-Done lives in the handoff), and sam/README.md's link is updated accordingly.
dowsure-implementation-handoff.md is simplified, has a summary box, and does not contradict the internal handoff or the matrix.
The two canonical design docs each have a plain-English summary box and simplified intros with substance preserved.
docs/QUICKSTART.md is a short 'start here' index with the status block replaced by a link to the matrix.
No doc presents getOrderMetrics as THE financing source without the Transactions + Financial Event Groups correction; no secrets/PII anywhere.
verification: `Test-Path docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md` is False and `git ls-files -- 'docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md'` returns nothing.
`Select-String -Path IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md -Pattern 'listTransactions','financialEventGroups','Quanzhou','Xiamen','10 October','Anudeep'` finds the merged content.

`Select-String -Path sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md -Pattern 'IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF'` confirms it is now a pointer; `Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern 'FLOWS.md','SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md','opinions.md','PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md'` confirms the full index.

`Select-String -Path README.md,docs/QUICKSTART.md,olea-dowsure-executive-proposal.md,olea-dowsure-technical-design.md -Pattern 'Plain-English','plain-English','In plain English'` confirms summary boxes exist.

Grep across all .md for a bare getOrderMetrics-as-financing claim: `Select-String -Path *.md,docs/*.md,sam/*.md,sam/docs/*.md,nitro-enclave/*.md -Pattern 'orderMetrics'` - every hit must sit near the Transactions/Financial Event Groups correction (manually confirm).
Every internal markdown link in README.md and docs/QUICKSTART.md resolves to an existing file.
findings: Done. Merged docs/NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md into IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md and git rm'd it (confirmed Test-Path False and git ls-files empty): Next Steps re-aimed from getOrderMetrics to Transactions (GET /finances/2024-06-19/transactions, listTransactions) + Financial Event Groups (GET /finances/v0/financialEventGroups, listFinancialEventGroups); kept fail-closed + no-local-mock; corrected to now-available sandbox framing (secrets out of band, never written); added the two sample suppliers (Quanzhou Feile E-commerce Co., Ltd; Xiamen Yunyu Tianji Network Technology Co., Ltd) as labels only; added the 10-Oct Dowsure dependency with Anudeep Sai Nunna as owner. Added a plain-English summary box to the handoff and a pointer line to the matrix; the historical measurements block (EIF SHA-256 246e2143..., PCR0/1/2) matches the matrix character-for-character (verified by grep against both files). Folded ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY's Definition-of-Done into the handoff and reduced sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md to a one-line pointer; updated sam/README.md link text accordingly. Simplified dowsure-implementation-handoff.md with a plain-English summary box + acronym expansions + a consistency note (CID 16/port 5005, TLSNotary placeholder, finances reorientation), preserving all mermaid diagrams and JSON. Added plain-English summary boxes and acronym expansions to the top of olea-dowsure-executive-proposal.md and olea-dowsure-technical-design.md with substance preserved (no tables, threat models, diagrams, or decision logs cut). Shortened docs/QUICKSTART.md to a start-here index with the status block replaced by a link to the matrix. Verification: all FEAT-004 checks pass - NEXT_AGENT_HANDOFF.md gone from disk and git; merged markers (listTransactions, financialEventGroups, Quanzhou, Xiamen, 10 October, Anudeep) found in the handoff; ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY is a pointer; README indexes FLOWS/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS/opinions/matrix; summary boxes present in README, QUICKSTART, and both design docs; every orderMetrics hit sits next to the Transactions/Financial Event Groups correction (handoff lines 68-69 explicitly say it is NOT the financing source; opinions.md/FLOWS.md/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md carry the correction); all internal links in README.md and docs/QUICKSTART.md resolve; no secrets/PII found in touched docs. Committed locally; not pushed.
